reason: Judge 1 passes engineering verification but its aggregation semantics admit unsafe adversarial multi-fixture and near-zero-output cases, and its load terminology, documentation, and evidence binding need correction before approval.
required_changes: Fix artwork spill aggregation so one clean beam cannot hide another high-spill live beam.
Prevent near-zero output from gaming geometric coverage through output-weighted spill.
Make multi-fixture target coverage semantics coherent by implementing combined coverage or temporarily constraining and enforcing the profile to exactly one fixture.
Add adversarial tests for bad secondary spill, near-zero-output gaming, and the declared multi-fixture policy.
Correct connected-load terminology and calculation so rated connected load and output-dependent demand are not conflated.
Update stale Judge 1 evaluator and profile version documentation.
If supported cleanly by the existing architecture, bind snapshot evidence to the exact canonical state revision or hash without introducing renderer or UI coupling.
protected_aspects: Preserve the pure, deterministic Judge 1 architecture and renderer independence.
Preserve Phase 2 canonical state, semantic geometry, SimulationSnapshot evidence ownership, fixed exposure, UI behavior, and all previously passing verification behavior.
Do not implement or start Judge 2, merge branches, or self-approve the corrected candidate.
